_doc: Authored concept entries for the HUD's nested tooltips and the in-game wiki stub (design/ux/hud.md, Tooltips; terms per design/glossary.md). Each entry: title, fact (the key fact line, optional), summary (one line), body (text where [[key|shown words]] is a highlighted word that opens that entry's tooltip). Greybox content: the wiki and its full entries come later.

linh_thach.title: Spirit stones (linh thạch)
linh_thach.summary: The only money of the cultivation world.
linh_thach.body: Stones holding condensed [[linh_khi|spiritual qi]]. Markets, sect services and teleport arrays price in them; they also fuel formations and an [[dong_phu|cave abode]].

linh_khi.title: Spiritual qi (linh khí)
linh_khi.summary: The world's energy that cultivators draw in.
linh_khi.body: Its density differs from place to place and decides how fast your [[tu_vi|cultivation base]] grows there. Your [[linh_can|spiritual root]] decides which elements you draw best.

dong_phu.title: Cave abode (động phủ)
dong_phu.summary: Your home: a room where you cultivate and keep things.
dong_phu.body: A spirit-gathering array there raises the [[linh_khi|spiritual qi]] density of your room. It is paid for in [[linh_thach|spirit stones]].

tu_vi.title: Cultivation base (tu vi)
tu_vi.summary: How far you have cultivated in your current level.
tu_vi.body: It grows each season you cultivate. When it is full, you attempt a [[dot_pha|breakthrough]] to the next level of your [[canh_gioi|realm]].

dot_pha.title: Breakthrough (đột phá)
dot_pha.summary: The attempt to rise to the next level or realm.
dot_pha.body: A failed attempt costs time and can hurt you. A [[binh_canh|bottleneck]] holds you at a realm's last level until a breakthrough succeeds.

binh_canh.title: Bottleneck (bình cảnh)
binh_canh.summary: The wall at the end of a realm.
binh_canh.body: Only a successful [[dot_pha|breakthrough]] passes it; until then your [[tu_vi|cultivation base]] stops growing.

canh_gioi.title: Realm (cảnh giới)
canh_gioi.body: From [[luyen_khi|Qi Refining (Luyện Khí)]] through Foundation Establishment (Trúc Cơ), Core Formation (Kết Đan) and Nascent Soul (Nguyên Anh) to Deity Transformation (Hóa Thần). Each realm adds [[tho_nguyen|lifespan]].

luyen_khi.title: Qi Refining (Luyện Khí)
luyen_khi.body: You start here, far weaker than most cultivators of the same realm. Each layer needs a fuller [[tu_vi|cultivation base]]; the stages are early, middle and late (sơ kỳ, trung kỳ, hậu kỳ).

tho_nguyen.title: Lifespan (thọ nguyên)
tho_nguyen.summary: How long you can live; when age reaches it, your life ends.
tho_nguyen.body: Each [[canh_gioi|realm]] you reach adds lifespan. Every [[mua|season]] you spend uses a quarter of a year.

mua.title: Season (mùa)
mua.summary: One turn: a quarter of a year.
mua.body: You choose one season focus, do any free actions, then end the turn. Each season costs [[tho_nguyen|lifespan]].

linh_can.title: Spiritual root (linh căn)
linh_can.summary: Your affinity for the five elements, set at birth.
linh_can.body: Its purity per element decides how well you draw each element's [[linh_khi|spiritual qi]] and which arts suit you.
